title: Doorway handoff — Immediate response
title_zh: 门口交接 — 即时处理
scenario: Mia marks Leo received, but Jordan has not answered the handoff.
scenario_zh: Mia已把Leo标为接收，Jordan却没有回应交接。
question: As director, when is the handoff actually complete, and what would you require both adults to say and check? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，怎样才算交接完成？你会要求两位成人说清并核对什么？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Mia should say, “Jordan, you have Leo now,” and wait for Jordan to reply, “I have Leo.” Check Leo against the receiving list. Mia remains responsible until the handoff is complete.
required_zh: Mia说清：“Jordan，现在把Leo交给你。”等Jordan明确回应，再按接收名单核对Leo。交接完成前，Mia继续负责。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Doorway handoff”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An adult nearby may not know that responsibility has changed. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

title: Shared utensil — Explaining the response
title_zh: 共用餐具 — 说明处理经过
scenario: A reviewer asks how potentially affected portions were separated.
scenario_zh: 审阅人员问怎样另放可能受影响餐份。
question: As the family child-care provider, would changing the spoon be enough, and how would you handle the food already affected? What factual timeline and evidence would you provide, and what uncertainty would you disclose?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，换勺子够吗？已经可能受到影响的食物怎么处理？你会提供什么真实时间线和证据，又会说明哪些不确定性？
required: Stop using the shared utensil. Set aside food affected by cross-contact, use clean equipment, and prepare a suitable replacement under the allergy plan.
required_zh: 停止共用餐具，把可能受到交叉接触影响的食物另放，用清洁用品按计划准备合适替代食物。
practical: Explain actual observations, actions, responsible people and results in order. Supply relevant authorized records and distinguish unresolved facts. Do not backdate, invent a completion or treat a polished explanation as proof of compliance.
practical_zh: 按顺序说明真实观察、行动、负责人和结果，提供相关获授权记录，并区分未知。不倒签、不编造完成，也不把说得漂亮当成合规证明。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Shared utensil”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. scenario: A home provider cannot clarify a vague return message.
scenario_zh: 家庭经营者无法问清含糊返园消息。
question: As the family child-care provider, what would you clarify before relying on this return-to-care message? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，依赖这份返园信息前，你需要问清什么？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？
required: Read what the return message actually says and compare it with applicable return criteria. Ask for clarification rather than treating an unclear note as automatic clearance.
required_zh: 读清返园信息，核对适用条件；不明确的地方先确认，不把模糊说明当作自动许可。
practical: Keep responsibility for the children, pause non-urgent competing tasks and use only a verified permitted backup. If the actual setting cannot support safe care, use the appropriate contingency process rather than inventing an available helper.
practical_zh: 你继续负责孩子，推迟不紧急的冲突任务，只使用已核实获准的备用人员。实际条件不能支持安全照护时，按应变安排处理，不假设有一个现成帮手。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Return note ambiguity”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. An unclear note does not settle every return-to-care requirement. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“返园说明不清”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。说明不清的返园纸条，不能解决所有返园条件。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify illness exclusion, return, notification, and health guidance for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证疾病离园、返园、通知与健康指导。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

scenario: A helper moves bathroom supplies directly onto the food cart.
scenario_zh: 帮手把卫生间用品直接放上餐车。
question: As the family child-care provider, what hygiene steps must come before food handling, and how would supervision continue meanwhile? Which tasks could you consider delegating, and which responsibilities must stay with eligible people?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，处理食物前要完成哪些卫生步骤？这期间怎样保持看护？你可以考虑交出哪些工作，哪些责任必须由合格人员保留？
required: After toileting help, complete the required handwashing steps before preparing food. Wearing gloves does not remove the need for hand hygiene.
required_zh: 协助如厕后，按正确步骤洗手，再接触食物；同时保持儿童有人照看。
practical: Consider only tasks allowed for the person’s actual role. Do not transfer supervision, count the helper as qualified staff or disclose private records merely because help was offered. Keep the safe-care responsibility clearly assigned.
practical_zh: 只考虑该人实际职责允许的任务。不因对方愿意帮忙，就交出看护、算作合格人员或开放私人记录。安全照护责任必须明确。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Hygiene shortcut”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Gloves do not replace the required hand hygiene steps. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.

question: As the family child-care provider, what would you change and test after this near-miss, and how would you determine whether a report is required? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?
question_zh: 作为家庭托育负责人，险情后要改变和测试什么，又怎样判断是否需要报告？哪些能自己做，哪些可以等，什么时候需要启用允许的备用或应变安排？
required: Remove the hazard and record what nearly happened for learning. Separately check whether this event meets any mandatory reporting rule.

title: Physical intervention ambiguity — Family explanation
title_zh: 身体干预不明 — 向家庭说明
scenario: A family asks what protective response was actually used.
scenario_zh: 家庭询问实际用了什么保护回应。
question: As director, how would you protect the group within training and legal limits without treating physical control as punishment? What would you tell the family now, what would remain private, and what separate notices might still be due?
question_zh: 作为园长，怎样在培训和法律范围内保护全组，不把身体控制当成惩罚？现在向家庭说明什么，哪些要保密，哪些另行通知责任仍需处理？
required: Move other children out of danger and use the least risky response within training and the applicable rules. Do not use physical control as punishment or teach a restraint from this workbook.
required_zh: 先让其他儿童远离危险，采用培训和规则范围内风险较小的保护方法；本书不教授约束技术。
practical: Explain the verified facts relevant to that family’s child and what you actually did. State what remains unknown, restrict unrelated private details and handle any applicable official notice or report separately.
practical_zh: 说明与该家庭孩子有关的已核实事实和实际行动，坦诚指出未知，限制无关隐私；另行处理适用的正式通知或报告。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Physical intervention ambiguity”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Physical control can create harm and must not become punishment. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“身体干预不明”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。身体控制可能造成伤害，也不能被当作惩罚。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。

Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.

title: Behavior labels — Immediate response
title_zh: 行为标签 — 即时处理
scenario: A peer took the truck, and Ava pushed a block toward that child. Ava's record says bad but omits the observed truck-and-block sequence.
scenario_zh: 同伴拿走小车后，Ava把积木推向对方。Ava记录只写坏，漏小车与积木经过。
question: As director, how would you rewrite the record to show the event, context, adult response and outcome? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，你会怎样重写记录，说明事件、背景、成人回应和结果？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Write the observed event: “After a peer took the truck, Ava pushed a block toward that child.” Add the actual adult response and outcome. If either is unknown, record that uncertainty rather than invent a helpful response.
required_zh: 写清观察事实：“同伴拿走小车后，Ava把积木推向对方。”再记实际成人回应和结果。不知道的地方如实注明，不为记录完整而编出一次帮助。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。

scenario: A pickup adult presents conflicting custody information.
scenario_zh: 接送成人提供冲突监护信息。
question: As director, how would you maintain safe care while current custody and release information are verified through the appropriate route? How would you divide the work now and prevent the response itself from leaving children unsupervised?
question_zh: 作为园长，怎样保持安全照护，同时通过适当渠道核实当前监护和接走资料？现在怎样分工，避免处理事情时又造成看护空档？
required: Keep the child safe while the designated lead verifies current court documents and applicable release requirements. Seek authorized legal or agency help rather than guess who has legal custody.
required_zh: 先安全照看儿童，由指定负责人核实有效法院文件和适用要求，必要时请正式法律或机构帮助。
practical: Keep the immediate safeguard in place while a named qualified person covers the children. Deal with routine paperwork after urgent care is secured.
practical_zh: 先落实眼前防护，由明确的合格人员继续看护。紧急照护安排好后，再处理常规文书。
records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Custody conflict”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. A pickup dispute may involve legal documents beyond staff authority to interpret. Record any unknown facts openly; use a dated correction rather than overwrite history.
records_best_practice_zh: 保留“监护信息冲突”相关事实：实际观察、时间、行动、负责人和结果。接送争议可能涉及员工无权自行解释的法律文件。 未知事项如实注明；更正留实际日期，不覆盖历史。
verify: Find and verify attendance, release authorization, custody information, and late pickup for the exact license class, age mix, local jurisdiction, and subsidy participation. Any statutory threshold, deadline, exception, or reporting duty remains unanswered until the applicable rule is reviewed. Confirm any required route, form, deadline, exception and license condition with the applicable California licensing, health, protective-reporting or subsidy authority. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
verify_zh: 按准确许可类别、年龄组合、当地辖区及补助参与情况，查证出勤、接走授权、监护信息与迟接规定。在适用规则审核前，法定门槛、期限、例外与报告义务均未确定。 向加州相应许可、卫生、保护报告或补助机构核实实际渠道、表格、时限、例外和许可条件。作法律判断前，先确认准确许可类别和项目。

question: As the family child-care provider, what consent scope and other restrictions must be checked before this new use of the photo? What can you do yourself, what can wait, and when would you need the permitted backup or contingency plan?

required: Do not post the photo under permission meant only for a private family update. Check the proposed use and any additional legal or program limits before sharing.

records_best_practice: Keep the factual evidence relevant to “Photo consent mismatch”: the actual observation, time, action, responsible person and result. Identify the exact license category and program before applying a legal conclusion.
